comment: Strand hair grown on our own MakeHuman bodies (docs/design/hair-physics.md 'Growing our own grooms'). tools/makehuman/grow_hair.py writes game/Saved/Grooms/<base>/<Style>.abc (and <Style>Hat, <Style>Under) from the base's FBX; the HairGrooms commandlet imports each as /Game/Rim3D/Generated/Grooms/GA_<base>_<Style>. 'creator' maps the creator's hair style names (the wig meshes) to a grown style; a creator style missing here keeps its wig at every distance. 'still' styles get no physics (Buzz is too short to move; the afro holds its own shape). Every other style swings, held in its grown shape against gravity (gravity preloading, stiff roots), so none sags onto the scalp (sneed 2026-11-25); the undercoats are never simulated.
